2026_02_JAX_DEN.headline: Jacksonville’s protection gets a Mile High test against a Denver offense missing speed
2026_02_JAX_DEN.paragraph1: Jacksonville enters Denver after a convincing opener and must handle the Broncos’ pass rush, altitude and home-field response without letting Trevor Lawrence live in long-yardage situations. Denver is without wide receiver Marvin Mims Jr., while running back RJ Harvey is questionable with a hamstring issue, putting more pressure on the Broncos to manufacture efficient early downs. Jacksonville can stress Denver if its protection holds; the Broncos need their defense to create short fields while the offense replaces Mims’ explosive element.
2026_02_JAX_DEN.model_rationale: Jacksonville’s pass protection and Denver’s ability to replace missing offensive speed should shape field position, explosive-play access and which side can stay ahead of the chains.
